other.name: Return dirty clothes from bedroom floor or chair to hamper

objects.name: clothing
objects.role: dirty items to be picked up and put away

objects.name: chair
objects.role: surface where clothes may be placed
objects.quote: Position: On the floor and/or draped on a chair.

starting_state.fact: There are approximately 5 to 10 clothing items present.
Clothing items are positioned on the floor and/or draped over a chair.
starting_state.quote: Position: On the floor and/or draped on a chair.

steps.text: Walk to the clothes and stand still for 1 second.
steps.quote: Walk to the clothes and stand still for 1 second.

steps.text: Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1–2 items with one hand using a full-palm grasp.
steps.quote: Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1–2 items with one hand using a full-palm grasp.

steps.text: Walk to the hamper and stop for 1 second.
steps.quote: Walk to the hamper and stop for 1 second.

steps.text: Hold items over the hamper opening and release them inside.
steps.quote: Hold items over the hamper opening and release them inside.

acceptance.criterion: The picked-up items are released inside the hamper.

constraints.violation_looks_like: Clothes are packed excessively into the hamper such that it overflows or items spill out over the rim.
A chair or other piece of furniture is tipped over, destabilized, or falls to the floor.

constraints.rule: Start step 2 with arms in a neutral position.
constraints.violation_looks_like: The person approaches or begins grasping while arms are already extended, raised, or not resting in a neutral position.
constraints.quote: Start with arms in a neutral position.

constraints.rule: Pick up 1–2 items with one hand using a full-palm grasp.
constraints.violation_looks_like: More than 2 items are picked up, two hands are used, or items are pinched with fingertips rather than grasped with a full palm.
constraints.quote: Pick up 1–2 items with one hand using a full-palm grasp.

not_modelled.reason: Instruction about dataset reset between recordings.
not_modelled.quote: Reset: Randomize item positions and types each episode. Vary hamper location (bedroom vs. closet).

not_modelled.reason: Instruction about variations to apply across recordings in the dataset.
not_modelled.quote: Diversity: Vary item types (shirts, pants, socks). Vary positions (floor vs. chair vs. bed edge). Vary number of items (1–3). Vary hamper location (bedroom vs. closet).
